turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Sure! Here is a rule: after he, she and it, we add -s to the verb. Example: I work. She works.

Now you try. Write the correct form: My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays. (Answer with only the verb.)
